hero.bio: Developer on the Marketplaces team at Loopia, where I build and maintain integrations between systems and marketplaces. Main stack: Python, FastAPI, Django and React.

about.label: / about
about.p1: I broke into the field in 2023 as a mobile developer, teaching myself to code. I soon moved to the backend, where I found the problems I enjoy most, and took on growing responsibilities.
about.p2: Progress came fast after that: from mobile dev to developer on the Marketplaces team at Loopia — responsible for integrations between systems and marketplaces. I'm also studying Information Systems at UNIFEBE and building my own projects on the side.
about.pivot: From the textile industry to AI development — in under 4 years.

agendabot.tagline: Automated scheduling via Telegram for freelancers
agendabot.description: A system that allows independent professionals to offer 24/7 scheduling via Telegram without manual replies. The bot autonomously manages time slots, confirmations and reminders. WhatsApp integration in development.

picking.tagline: Picking app for KYLY textile industry
picking.description: Mobile app and web dashboard to optimize the parts-picking process at KYLY, a textile company in Brusque, SC. Academic team project with its own backend, built with Flutter.

experience.label: / experience
experience.loopia_desc: On the Marketplaces team, I build and maintain integrations on a high-demand platform — robust, scalable and reliable. Stack: Python, FastAPI, Django.
experience.dextak_desc: Mobile app development for agency clients using Flutter and Dart.
